Class CardInfoCatalog

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.GUI.CardInfoCatalog
public class CardInfoCatalog extends Object
Builds rich, human-readable Italian descriptions for every card and tile, used as hover tooltips in the game view. The card/tile data under /json/ is read once at construction and turned into a finished description string per card id (and per offer-tile letter); failures are swallowed so an unknown id simply falls back to a generic label.

The wording mirrors the official rulebook terminology (Personaggi, Edifici, Eventi, tessere Offerta / Ordine di Turno).
